## Avatar

Solo service business owner. Agency, consultant, or freelancer doing roughly
ten to forty thousand a month. Thirty-something to forty-something. Wears every
hat. The business runs on their personal effort and they feel it. They are
proud of being the one who can do the work, and that pride is exactly what keeps
them stuck. They are scared that hiring or documenting will lower quality, so
they keep doing it themselves and stay slammed.

## Top 3 perceived problems (viewer language)

1. **I am drowning in the work and there is never enough time.** Every week is
   delivery, delivery, delivery, and there is no room to work on the business.
2. **Everything depends on me. I cannot delegate or step away.** If they take a
   week off, the business stops. They are the bottleneck on everything.
3. **I am undercharging and overworking and I know it.** They suspect their
   prices are too low, but raising them feels risky, so they grind instead.
